high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "arunaguhan." The post shows a person taking a mirror selfie in what appears to be an elevator. The individual is wearing a traditional outfit, which includes a light-colored blouse with intricate embroidery on the sleeves and a matching saree with a gradient of orange and yellow hues. The saree is draped elegantly over one shoulder. The person is holding a smartphone in their right hand, which they are using to take the photo. In their left hand, they are holding a set of keys and a small black pouch or wallet.
